statement: Coordinate prefill admission within an active expert-parallel collective group
mechanism: Proposed, untested adaptation of deadline-aware chunking: each rank retains local request ownership, while ranks that must enter the same MoE collective agree on an iteration-level prefill limit using the slowest predicted participating rank. A collective group is determined from the resolved backend and process groups, not assumed to equal all eight GPUs. Independent replicas make separate decisions.
change: The candidate addition is a group-scoped admission contract that accounts for rank skew, collective participation, supported graph shapes, and KV capacity. Whether the historical pinned runtime already has equivalent behavior is unverified.
